hook: SCP-072 turns a bedtime fear into a containment file: a shadowy, hand-shaped projection that appears only in the dark, only during deep sleep, and only if a foot is left uncovered. Content note: what it does to sleepers involves serious injury, told in a flat, clinical tone. The article is short, and its effect rests on how precisely it pins down those conditions.
whyItMatters: It takes something close to a childhood superstition and gives it full Foundation paperwork. The trigger is so specific that it reads almost like folklore, and the detached voice makes the old habit of tucking your feet under the blanket feel suddenly reasonable. It is a good example of how much atmosphere one well-defined rule can carry.
thingsToNotice: The containment procedures barely mention the hand itself and focus on keeping bedding away from the cell, a choice that only makes sense once you reach the note about how the anomaly spreads. The addendum list is where the file quietly escalates, moving from recovered furniture to test items, with one entry cut off by an expunged line. Small measured details, like the light threshold in lux, make the thing feel recorded rather than imagined.
